description: This file provides helper methods for working with ReadOnlySequence<byte> and related buffer segments, including batching byte sequences and creating ReadOnlySequence objects from various buffer collections.

classes.name: ReadOnlySequenceHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing extension methods for batching byte sequences and creating ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances from various buffer collections.

classes.name: ReadOnlyBufferSegment
classes.description: A private nested class extending ReadOnlySequenceSegment<byte> to facilitate building linked segments for ReadOnlySequence<byte>.

methods.name: Batch
methods.description: Splits an IEnumerable<byte> into batches of specified size, yielding each batch as a byte array.

methods.name: ToReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Converts an IEnumerable<byte[]> or IEnumerable<Memory<byte>> into a ReadOnlySequence<byte>.

methods.name: CreateReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Creates a ReadOnlySequence<byte> from an array of byte arrays.
